WorkAdventure test source fixtures from commit `96d43a841766b22418c061744e7ed2aafd9870d3`. Author: WorkAdventure. These fixtures are used only for pinned compatibility checks; they are not part of the map release.

Sources: https://github.com/workadventure/workadventure/blob/96d43a841766b22418c061744e7ed2aafd9870d3/libs/map-editor/src/GameMap/MapValidator.ts and https://github.com/workadventure/workadventure/blob/96d43a841766b22418c061744e7ed2aafd9870d3/libs/map-editor/src/GameMap/Validator/ZipFileFetcher.ts . SHA-256 assertions in the harness reject fixture changes.

The archive-validator fixtures above are untouched files from `@workadventure/map-editor`, whose upstream package declares ISC.

`StartPositionCalculator.ts.txt` is the untouched [play client calculator](https://github.com/workadventure/workadventure/blob/96d43a841766b22418c061744e7ed2aafd9870d3/play/src/front/Phaser/Game/StartPositionCalculator.ts), SHA-256 `78ba5907ff74458ee4bcbb8faf2a6c4daa5071b8c905ae85ff0c83cfed8ca7ad`. `StartLayerMethods.ts.txt` contains the untouched `getRandomPositionFromLayer` and `isStartObject` method excerpts from [GameMapFrontWrapper](https://github.com/workadventure/workadventure/blob/96d43a841766b22418c061744e7ed2aafd9870d3/play/src/front/Phaser/Game/GameMap/GameMapFrontWrapper.ts); excerpt SHA-256 `7d722386465a4538ee6e53841ef00a73a4773d72c68e9d2b38d9c4c745a8b390`, complete upstream file SHA-256 `8127a77f1ff4d1d48a93a08dd96c7dfc0654a8b398c95d7bfe3bdb58ae1b41c2`. The harness supplies only the browser persistence/map boundary and deterministic random sampling, then executes these actual methods against the authored/exported hub.

The play/client fixtures are covered by the upstream play license notices, not the map-editor ISC declaration. Retained [Play-LICENSE.txt](Play-LICENSE.txt) is the actual pinned `play/LICENSE.txt`; its package declares `SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.txt`. That license text refers to NOTICE.txt and LICENSES.txt, but those two paths return404 in this pinned tree, so no copies or availability claims are made here.
